decisions.reason: It is distant from the firm's core maritime expertise and has shown no dedicated page or quantified results, making it a likely candidate for discontinuation.
It builds on the firm's established crew recruitment capabilities and remains mentioned on the website, indicating ongoing commitment.
The maritime education programme has its own page and a growing partner network, demonstrating active development and market traction.
